simple.meaning: בְּלוֹא (bᵉlôwʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “(only in plural construction) rags.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Jeremiah 38:11. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּלוֹא (H1094) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: בְּלוֹא (bᵉlôwʼ) / H1094 is traced through Jeremiah 38:11, Jeremiah 38:12 with generated occurrence evidence.
